🔨THE GAME IS STILL IN ALPHA, BUG AND ERRORS ARE TO BE EXPECTED. 🔨

Piggy Rush is a survival game in which 8 players must survive a monster from a variety of Piggy Fangames across different maps and events, using items around the map and parts of the environment to help while completing tasks to reduce the round timer and earn coins.
Want to try surviving?
